class.name: PlayFabLobby
class.description: Returned by lobby create/join APIs. Getters expose cached snapshots that are refreshed before lobby state-change signals are emitted.

method.name: set_properties_async
method.description: Updates this lobby's [member properties] (visible only to lobby members; hidden from [method PlayFabMultiplayer.find_lobbies_async] results) and returns a completion [Signal]. Owner-only; non-owner callers receive a failure result. Dictionary keys must be [String] or [StringName]. Values must be [String] or [StringName] (or [code]null[/code] to delete that key), and omitted keys are left unchanged. Shorthand for [method post_update_async] with only [member PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.lobby_properties] assigned.

method.name: set_member_properties_async
method.description: Updates this local member's [member PlayFabLobbyMember.properties] in the lobby and returns a completion [Signal]. Can only edit the local member's entry — see [member PlayFabLobbyConfig.member_properties] for scope details. Dictionary keys must be [String] or [StringName]. Values must be [String] or [StringName] (or [code]null[/code] to delete that key), and omitted keys are left unchanged. On success, the local member snapshot is updated before the completion signal and [code]MEMBER_UPDATED[/code] state change are emitted, even when the native SDK does not raise a separate local-self property callback.

method.name: set_search_properties_async
method.description: Updates this lobby's [member search_properties] and returns a completion [Signal]. Owner-only. Keys must use the reserved [code]string_keyN[/code] / [code]number_keyN[/code] names PlayFab requires for search. Values must be [String] or [StringName] (or [code]null[/code] to delete that key), and omitted keys are left unchanged. Shorthand for [method post_update_async] with only [member PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.search_properties] assigned.

method.name: set_membership_lock_async
method.description: Opens or closes the lobby to new joins and returns a completion [Signal]. Owner-only. Pass [constant MEMBERSHIP_LOCK_LOCKED] to seal the lobby once a match starts, or [constant MEMBERSHIP_LOCK_UNLOCKED] to reopen it; existing members are unaffected either way. Shorthand for [method post_update_async] with only [member PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.membership_lock] assigned.

method.name: post_update_async
method.description: Applies every field assigned on [param update] in a single service round trip and returns a completion [Signal]. Use this instead of chaining the single-field helpers when changing several settings at once, so the lobby never sits in a half-updated state and members observe one batch of state changes. Fails immediately with the [code]invalid_update[/code] error code when [param update] is [code]null[/code], is empty, or carries an out-of-range value. Changing configuration is owner-only, except that [member PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.new_owner_entity_key] may be claimed by any member under manual or disabled owner migration.

method.name: leave_async
method.description: Leaves this lobby and returns a completion [Signal].

method.name: is_owner
method.description: Returns whether [param user] is the current owner snapshot.

method.name: is_disconnected
method.description: Returns whether the local user's session with this lobby has ended. A disconnected lobby is excluded from [method PlayFabMultiplayer.get_lobbies] and its async methods fail.

method.name: find_member
method.description: Returns the cached [PlayFabLobbyMember] whose entity key matches [param entity_key] (as [code]{"id": ..., "type": ...}[/code]), or [code]null[/code] when no such member is in the current snapshot.

members.member: Lobby string properties (the [member PlayFabLobbyConfig.lobby_properties] bucket). Visible only to lobby members; hidden from [method PlayFabMultiplayer.find_lobbies_async] results.

Search string properties (the [member PlayFabLobbyConfig.search_properties] bucket). Visible to anyone who can discover the lobby. Editable after create through [method set_search_properties_async] or [member PlayFabLobbyUpdateConfig.search_properties].
Cached lobby visibility; compare against [PlayFabLobbyConfig]'s [code]ACCESS_POLICY_*[/code] constants. Refreshed before [constant CONFIGURATION_UPDATED] is emitted.
Cached owner migration behavior; compare against [PlayFabLobbyConfig]'s [code]OWNER_MIGRATION_*[/code] constants. Fixed at create time.
Cached join lock; one of [constant MEMBERSHIP_LOCK_UNLOCKED] or [constant MEMBERSHIP_LOCK_LOCKED]. Refreshed before [constant CONFIGURATION_UPDATED] is emitted.
Cached owner-only-invite flag. Always [code]false[/code] when built against a GDK older than April 2026 ([code]260400[/code]), which does not report this setting.

Why the local user's session ended; one of the [code]DISCONNECTING_*[/code] constants, or [constant PlayFabLobbyStateChange.REASON_NONE] while still connected. Cached from [constant DISCONNECTING] so it survives into [constant DISCONNECTED], which the native SDK reports without a reason of its own.

signal.name: state_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the lobby snapshot refreshes.

constants.constant: A lobby member was removed. [member PlayFabLobbyStateChange.reason] carries a [code]MEMBER_REMOVED_*[/code] constant explaining whether the member left voluntarily or was removed.
Lobby properties changed. Only emitted when the update actually carried member-visible lobby properties; [member PlayFabLobbyStateChange.properties] lists the changed keys.

Lobby session ended for the local user. Fires both when [code]leave_async()[/code] completes and when the SDK observes an unexpected disconnect. [member PlayFabLobbyStateChange.reason] carries the [code]DISCONNECTING_*[/code] constant cached from [constant DISCONNECTING]; [member PlayFabLobbyStateChange.result] is OK only for [constant DISCONNECTING_NO_LOCAL_MEMBERS] (the normal end of a session) and reports a failure for every unexpected reason.

A lobby member's [member PlayFabLobbyMember.connection_status] changed. Emitted in addition to [constant MEMBER_UPDATED] for the same member, so existing [constant MEMBER_UPDATED] listeners keep working and listeners that only care about connectivity can match the narrower kind.
Lobby search properties changed. [member PlayFabLobbyStateChange.properties] lists the changed keys.

Lobby configuration changed. [member PlayFabLobbyStateChange.properties] carries only the fields that actually changed, keyed by [code]max_member_count[/code], [code]access_policy[/code], [code]membership_lock[/code], and [code]restrict_invites_to_lobby_owner[/code], each holding its refreshed value.

The local user's session is ending. [member PlayFabLobbyStateChange.reason] carries a [code]DISCONNECTING_*[/code] constant. The lobby handle is still valid here but will not be once [constant DISCONNECTED] arrives, so read anything you need at this point.
New members may not join. Existing members stay in the lobby.
A local user left the lobby voluntarily.
A local user was removed by the lobby owner or by the service.
A remote member left the lobby.
The last local member left; this is the normal end of a session and is reported with an OK result.
The lobby was deleted on the service.
The client lost its connection to the lobby service.
The lobby's game server left the lobby.
